scientific_integrity: Geometric inversion and complete S4 fixed-point computation establish the all-prime and all-extension claims; standalone exact verifier independently checks every permutation and all five forms over F3. No numerical interpolation used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields only; reduced complement of all nine geometric lines. Complete zeta and point-count formulas for the five quartic etale forms; independent research audit remains to be performed. Historical-priority limitation: Hunt 2000 full text was inaccessible; classical line equations make an earlier derivation conceivable.
title: Five arithmetic spectra for the line-free locus of Cayley cubic twists
